defs.def: something that you feel you have to do because it is your moral or legal responsibility 责任；义务；本分

ex.s: It gives her a sense of duty.

ex.t: 许多西方人来到中国后做饭比在自己国家少得多，因为他们意识到在外面吃有多便宜。

ex.s: （1）What is the main duty of the fire prevention professionals？
The parents had done their duty and would probably continue to do so.
ex.t: "对我来说，这就是重新情境化。
但有些植物则身兼二职。

ex.s: Some plants pump out smelly chemicals to keep insects away.But others do double duty .They pump out perfumes designed to attract different insects who are natural enemies to the attackers.Once they arrive,the tables are turned .The attacker who was lunching now becomes lunch.
ex.t: 学年____之前，我给孩子们发了一份特殊____——印有"动词是你的____"字样的T恤衫。

defs.def: the work that is your job 上班；值班

ex.s: Sadness wants to do her duty but by accident causes the loss of Riley’s happy core memories with Joy.
ex.t: Sadness 想履行她的职责，但意外导致 Riley 与 Joy 的快乐核心记忆的丢失。

ex.s: I speak with the on-duty nurse, who tells me that Lara's parents rushed her to the hospital after she fell off her bicycle.
ex.t: 我和值班护士交谈，她告诉我 Lara 的父母在她从自行车上摔下来后急忙把她送到了医院。

ex.s: Key duties include exploring the islands of the reef and finding out what the area has to offer.
ex.t: 主要职责包括探索珊瑚礁的岛屿并了解该地区有哪些资源。

ex.s: When I saw the tragic scenes on the news, I felt it was my duty as a doctor to go there and offer my help.
ex.t: 当我在新闻上看到那些悲惨的场景时，我觉得作为一名医生，我有责任去那里提供帮助。

ex.s: I have full confidence in your courage, devotion to duty and skill in battle.
ex.t: 我对你们的勇气、忠于职守和作战技能充满信心。

defs.def: tasks that are part of your job 职责；任务
